cases.case_name: Messy fresh-context status call, no prior stored context
cases.purpose: Mimics the informal, interruption-heavy phrasing of a real status call (false starts, filler words, cross-talk, a dependency risk raised conversationally rather than as a formal risk statement) for a project with no stored context yet. Verifies the pipeline still produces a sane baseline report and never fabricates retrieval evidence when none exists.
cases.transcript:
Dev: OK so, sorry, can everyone hear me? Great. Right, let's do a quick run through, I know we're all a bit pressed for time today.
Sana: Yeah go ahead, go ahead.
Dev: So on the server migration, the -- sorry, the lift-and-shift piece, that's basically done, we cut over the staging environment last Tuesday and it's held up fine since.
Sana: Nice one. And production?
Dev: Production is, um, it's scheduled, we're targeting the weekend of the 14th, but I want to flag, the network team still haven't confirmed the firewall rule changes, so that could push us back a week if it doesn't land in time.
Sana: Right. So that's a dependency risk then really.
Dev: Yeah I'd call it a risk, honestly. It's not blocked yet but if we don't hear from them by Friday we're stuck.
Sana: OK, noted. What about the database replication testing?
Dev: That one's actually gone really well, we ran the failover drill twice this week, both times it recovered inside the target window, so I'm happy calling that complete.
Sana: Great, good to hear something's straightforward.
Dev: Ha, yeah. One more thing, the cost report the client asked for, I haven't started that yet, I've been heads down on the migration, I'll try get to it next week.
Sana: OK, let's keep an eye on that one, don't want it slipping too far.

cases.case_name: Existing stored milestone silently carried forward while a new risk surfaces
cases.purpose: A previously-tracked milestone (regional training rollout) gets no mention at all this week because the team is firefighting an unrelated support-ticket backlog -- exactly the realistic case where a milestone must be carried forward from stored context rather than silently dropped just because this week's transcript didn't touch it.
cases.transcript:
Priya: Right, thanks everyone for jumping on, I know it's a Friday afternoon so I'll keep this tight.
Owen: No worries, go for it.
Priya: So the main thing this week is the vendor contract renewal, that one's now signed, finally, after going back and forth on the liability clause for about three weeks.
Owen: Oh good, that's been dragging.
Priya: It has. Anyway that's done. The bigger concern honestly is the support ticket backlog, it's crept up again, we're at, I think, forty-something open tickets now versus the usual fifteen to twenty.
Owen: Is that a staffing thing or is it just volume?
Priya: Bit of both if I'm honest. We lost Marcus to the other team and we haven't backfilled yet, so yeah, I'd flag that as a risk, we could start missing our response time SLA if it keeps climbing like this.
Owen: Agreed, let's get that visible. Anything on the training rollout?
Priya: Nothing to report there this week, we didn't touch it, too busy firefighting the tickets.

activeMilestones.description: Roll out the new support playbook training to all regional teams.

latestAssessment.summary: Training modules for two of four regions have been delivered.

cases.case_name: Fresh low-risk update does not invent retrieval evidence
cases.purpose: A short positive project update with no stored context. This is a realistic first-use case where the report should stay conservative, avoid invented project memory, and keep retrieval mode at none.
cases.transcript: Mia: Quick update. Payments integration is complete now. Stripe checkout passed live testing yesterday. Onboarding email redesign is on track; first draft is approved and build starts tomorrow. The team agreed to keep the current launch date.

cases.case_name: Retrieved knowledge remains background when transcript omits it
cases.purpose: Stored knowledge says a security review is a go-live constraint, but the transcript only mentions UAT and release notes. This guards the boundary between useful background memory and transcript evidence.
cases.transcript: Ava: The deployment checklist is moving. UAT is complete and the release notes are drafted. No one mentioned security sign-off today, so let's not invent a status for that. Ben: Agreed, just note UAT complete and release notes drafted.

chunks.title: SoW constraint
chunks.content: The client cannot go live before the security review is signed off.

cases.case_name: Existing risk is updated without duplicate risk spam
cases.purpose: A realistic follow-up where an already tracked data migration risk is still active but improving. The same risk should be recognised instead of creating a fresh duplicate risk.
cases.transcript: Leo: Data migration defects remain active. The count is down from twenty-four to six after daily triage. Nina: Keep daily triage until the defect count is under three.

activeRisks.description: Open defects in migrated customer records may delay go-live.

cases.case_name: Omitted active milestone is carried forward cleanly
cases.purpose: A weekly update covers a support backlog and deliberately says the training rollout has no update. The stored milestone should remain visible as carried-forward context rather than disappearing.
cases.transcript: Priya: The support backlog is down to eighteen open tickets after the weekend triage. We did not touch the training rollout this week, so there is no new update for that. Owen: Fine, keep the rollout on the watch list and focus next week on the final region.

activeMilestones.description: Roll out the new support playbook training to all regional teams.

latestAssessment.summary: Training modules for three of four regions have been delivered.

cases.case_name: Sparse noisy call does not create a busy report
cases.purpose: A low-substance update call with setup chatter and no concrete project facts should not produce a pile of fake milestones or risks just to fill the report.
cases.transcript: Sam: Can everyone hear me? I think we may need to move this because half the team is missing. Jo: Yeah, let's park the proper update until Thursday. Sam: Fine, no project decisions today then.

cases.case_name: Prior at-risk health can remain at risk when dependency is unresolved
cases.purpose: A dependency remains unresolved across reports. This guards against a bland positive summary flipping the project to green when the transcript still says the blocker has not moved.
cases.transcript: Nora: The API gateway integration is at risk because client credentials still have not arrived. We chased again yesterday but there is no answer yet. Build work around it is fine, but that dependency could delay launch. Ravi: Keep it amber until credentials arrive.

recentReports.summary: Client credentials were blocking the API gateway integration.
